newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends broadly up on fund buying.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends broadly up on fund buying.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures followed the rally in other wheat markets and closed broadly higher on buying by funds, traders said.
"We shot up on stop-close-only buying by the funds," a Minneapolis floor source said.
Traders said a good chunk of the fund buying followed the expiry of March wheat options in all three markets. CBOT traders said buy stops were hit above the $3.70 March strike.
Amid all the talk of technical buying, some Minneapolis sources said part of the market's strength came on fundamental concerns about deliverable stocks.

"There's still a tight deliverable situation in Kansas City, Minneapolis and Chicago. Nobody's going to want to be short going into delivery period," a trader said. First notice date for MGE wheat is next Friday.

MGE spring wheat settled 6-3/4 to 9-1/2 cents per bushel higher, with March up 9-1/2 cents at $4.03-3/4. The last time the March contract closed above that level was Oct 14, 1996, when it settled at $4.06-3/4.
Commission house Wilson Trading was a featured player, buying 2.3 million May bushels and selling one million May. Atwood/Peavey bull-spread 1.5 million March/May at 18-1/2 to 19 cents.
MGE barley futures did not trade.
